title: Film work payment
tagline: Payments for film cast/crew using escrow, with NFTs as receipts that contain on-set reminders.
description:
This is a project for film producers to pay their film workers. I envisioned a project d'app to be able to connect to wallets and pay them each time they connected. The smart contract would have milestones and pay them based off of chainlink oracles, incorporate union rules, and even residuals. However this hackathon project is a real basic d'app and the absolute start of something great. 

It's what I wanted when I was on set and filling out paperwork for pay while trying to do cleanup and waiting for the martini shot.
how_its_made:
This project was made with React/Vite, Tailwinds, and ethers. It was a definite challenge as I wasn't able to piece together all of the dependencies together. I thought this tech stack was important as I've often shied away from major frameworks especially in web3. There's a huge amount to get right. I don't think I got it right with vite not loading like I want it to. 

I was initially going for PYUSD but ended up not doing that and trying to get it shipped. I am just happy that I got a smart contract out on testnet and some real basic functionality.
